_comment: Provenance for the icons in this directory. Every field below is copied from the generation spec named in `prompt_file` in the `source_repo` repository; nothing here is inferred. These images are MACHINE-GENERATED art, not photographs or hand-drawn work.
selection_rule: The spec records exactly one `selected_variant` per slot. Only that variant is kept here; the other generated variants were removed in chore/remove-rejected-icon-variants because publishing them made rejected art indistinguishable from chosen art.
